A quick battle lesson. Unusable Gin Tama,
or ones with no effect,

Red! 3x speed!

Gin Tama Battles
are turn-based.
You and the enemy alternate. Each character's Speed
determines who
attacks first. At the top of the screen:
HP is the upper bar,
Spirit is the lower one. Use your Gin Tama
to reduce either
of these to zero to win. HP mainly drops
from physical attacks
using Fight Gin Tama. Spirit mainly drops
from mental attacks
using Kotodama Gin Tama. Gin Tama come in Fight,
Kotodama and Effect types,
with attack and defense uses. Don't just attack.
Defend and use Effect Tama
strategically to win.

Some Gin Tama
activate immediately
when used. Others are placed
face-down until their
activation conditions occur. Each character can set
up to three face-down Tama. You can't tell which Tama
an enemy has set. Many face-down Tama
are conditional defenses
or traps. Be careful. Some Gin Tama
remove face-down Tama
or reveal what they are. Others are immune
to face-down Tama.
Use them to your advantage.

Some Gin Tama
show a character.
These are Character Tama. Their basic effect
is summoning. Use one in battle
to summon that character
for a powerful attack. But if the enemy
is the character
that Tama summons... You can't use it
against them. There are many
Character Tama.
Find and use them! Some Character Tama
have special effects
beyond summoning. Others provide
a Kotodama Boost.

Kotodama Boost
is a special Character Tama
and Effect attack support. Use one in battle,
and a small icon
remains onscreen for a while. During that time,
your Kotodama attacks
get automatic follow-ups. The Kotodama Boost
piles onto your
verbal attacks... Dealing more
Spirit damage
than usual. Kotodama Boost
requires nerve
and a vicious tongue. Only certain characters
can provide it.
Find out who!

Various conditions
can stop you using
a Gin Tama in battle. For example, HP healing
won't work at full HP.
The same goes for Spirit. Character-specific Tama
and restrictions on Tama
can also prevent their use. Unusable Gin Tama
are shown in gray.
